settings.brief: Two compact side-by-side one-storey redbrick homes under one shared charcoal pitched roof. Exactly two front doors near the middle, two broad outer front living windows, separate rear GLASS patio sliders, two roof vents. No upstairs floor or garage. An ordinary affordable duplex, distinct from the two-storey2010stownhouse pair.
settings.identity_policy: All doors/windows/balconies/roof panels belong to one fixed world; never substitute front geometry on rear or move panels to the camera-facing roof.
